steps: iFinD uses the Yuanjing Digital Employee OAuth public client for this local runtime.
The client allows loopback callback URLs (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/oauth/callback); the port may change on every launch.
After signing in, one grant covers the iFinD MCP resource.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current iFinD MCP tool with JSON arguments after checking its live schema with list_tools.

serverType.description: The iFinD MCP service that owns the requested tool.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool; serialized arguments must not exceed 1000000 bytes.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current iFinD MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the iFinD MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current iFinD tools and their live input schemas for financial data, enterprise information, or legal content.

serverType.description: The iFinD MCP service that owns the requested tool.

inputSchema.description: The iFinD MCP service whose tools should be discovered.

serverType.description: The iFinD MCP service that owns the requested tool.

name.description: The exact iFinD MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by iFinD MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform destructive operations.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeated calls with the same arguments are expected to be idempotent.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside iFinD.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by iFinD.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by iFinD MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by one iFinD MCP service.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by the selected iFinD MCP service.

outputSchema.description: The current tool catalog for one iFinD MCP service.
